events.name: Chico Bean
events.info: Chico BeanChico Bean known as ⅓ of the 85 South Show, knows how to deliver a well-executed joke. Chico Bean has the uncanny ability to memorize almost instantly the words to an old song or create a new quirky jingle on the spot. Chico contributed his skills to the long-running sketch-variety television show Wild N Out hosted weekly by Nick Cannon. Other credits include the Freestyle Funny Comedy Show and MTV 2s Guy Court. You can currently see Chico Bean on set with the entire 85 South Show cracking jokes and speaking on topics that matter. venues.parkingDetail: Cost: Event Parking: Before 5PM: $6.00 After 5PM: $7.00 In/Out Pass: $8.00 (In/Out Good Only For Day of Purchase @ Parking Booth) NON-EVENT PARKING (DAILY): $6.00 VIP Parking available for select events is $23.00 Elite VIP Parking: VIP Parking is open for ticket holders only, subject to availability Selected Blaisdell Arena events, please enter off of Ward Ave. South (Makai) of Box Office Selected Concert Hall and Exhibition events, please enter off of Ward Ave. between Exhibition Hall and Concert Hall Note: No left turn permitted on Ward Ave. into driveways Hours of Operation is 1 1/2 hours prior to event until end of event time Box Office Parking: Box Office Parking is open for ticket buyers only. Parking for the patrons of the Box Office is free. If Box Office Parking is full, ticket buyers may enter through the King Street Gate. The ticket buyers will be refunded the parking fee after they validate their ticket at the Box Office. King Street Entrance: This is the main entrance to the Blaisdell Parking Lot. The gate opens at 5:30 a.m., Monday through Saturday. The gate closes at 6:00 p.m. on all evenings with no event scheduled. The gate closes 45 minutes after the last event is completed. On Sundays and Holidays, gate operation is determined by events. Kapiolani Entrance: This entrance is closed when there are no events scheduled. Only cardholders can access this gate when it is unattended. Signs are posted to direct non-card holders to the King Street entrance. This gate will also be open two hours prior to the opening of all major events scheduled in the central areas and will remain open until the completion of the last event. Hours of Operation: Event Days (Mon thru Fri) 5:30am to the end of night (event night) Event Days (Weekends & Holidays) 2 Hours prior to start of event to the end of night Parking Booths close 45 minutes prior to end of last event.

events.name: Charlie Brown Christmas
events.info: 92.3 KSSK - Hawaiʻi's Christmas Station Presents Mike Lewis Big Band Local trumpeter and bandleader Mike Lewis returns to the club with his 17-piece big band! Now in his !!th year of Big Band Monday Residency at Blue Note Hawaii, Mike Lewis caps his illustrious 55th round the world show biz career trumpeting with the best; Tony Bennett, Billy Joel, Frank Sinatra, Sarah Vaughn, Wynton Marsalis, Sammy Davis and even Hawaii's own Kalapana, C&K and Bruno Mars to name just a few. Mike & his band will be playing all your favorite hits from "A Charlie Brown Christmas" Soundtrack. Mike also holds the record for the most shows performed and produced at Blue Note Hawaii.
